model.ecommerce.dim_date.raw_code:
with spine as (
    select unnest(
        generate_series(
            date '2010-12-01',
            date '2011-12-31',
            interval '1 day'
        )
    ) as date_day
)
select
    date_day,
    year(date_day)                      as year,
    month(date_day)                     as month,
    week(date_day)                      as week_num,
    dayofweek(date_day)                 as weekday_num,
    dayname(date_day)                   as weekday_name,
    monthname(date_day)                 as month_name,
    month(date_day) in (11, 12)         as is_peak_season,
    case
        when strftime(date_day, '%m-%d') between '02-10' and '02-16'
            then 'Valentines'
        when strftime(date_day, '%m-%d') between '12-15' and '12-31'
            then 'Christmas'
        when strftime(date_day, '%m-%d') between '10-25' and '10-31'
            then 'Halloween'
        else null
    end                                 as commercial_event
from spine

-- dim_payment : proxy via mode_of_shipment (dataset Shipping)
-- Le dataset UCI Online Retail ne contient pas de mode de paiement.

-- comme dimension de traitement de commande, corrélée au canal d'achat.

    mode_of_shipment                        as payment_mode_proxy,
    COUNT(*)                                as nb_orders,
    ROUND(AVG(discount_pct), 1)             as avg_discount_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(customer_rating), 2)          as avg_satisfaction,
    ROUND(AVG(estimated_shipping_cost), 2)  as avg_shipping_cost,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_on_time = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          / COUNT(*), 1)                    as pct_on_time,
    -- enrichissement métier
    case mode_of_shipment
        when 'Ship'   then 'Maritime — délai long, coût faible'
        when 'Flight' then 'Aérien — délai court, coût élevé'
        when 'Road'   then 'Routier — délai moyen, coût moyen'
    end                                     as mode_description
from {{ ref('stg_shipping') }}
group by mode_of_shipment

model.ecommerce.mart_cohorts.name: mart_cohorts
model.ecommerce.mart_cohorts.description: Rétention mensuelle par cohorte d'acquisition — heatmap 12x12
model.ecommerce.mart_cohorts.raw_code:
-- ============================================================
-- mart_cohorts : Rétention par cohorte d'acquisition — ST2
-- Cohorte = mois du premier achat
-- 1 ligne = 1 cohorte × 1 mois_ordre avec nb clients actifs
-- ============================================================

with first_purchase as (
    -- Mois du premier achat par client (cohorte)
    select
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', min(invoice_date))   as cohort_month,
        min(invoice_date)                        as first_order_date
    from fact_transactions
    group by customer_id
),

orders_with_cohort as (
    -- Joindre chaque commande à la cohorte du client
    select
        t.customer_id,
        f.cohort_month,
        date_trunc('month', t.invoice_date)       as order_month,
        -- Indice de période (0 = mois d'acquisition)
        datediff('month', f.cohort_month, date_trunc('month', t.invoice_date)) as period_number
    from fact_transactions t
    inner join first_purchase f using (customer_id)
),

cohort_size as (
    -- Taille de chaque cohorte (nb clients au mois 0)
    select
        cohort_month,
        count(distinct customer_id) as cohort_size
    from first_purchase
    group by cohort_month
),

retention_raw as (
    -- Nb de clients actifs par cohorte × période
    select
        cohort_month,
        period_number,
        count(distinct customer_id) as active_customers
    from orders_with_cohort
    group by cohort_month, period_number
)

select
    r.cohort_month,
    strftime(r.cohort_month, '%Y-%m')               as cohort_label,
    r.period_number,
    r.active_customers,
    s.cohort_size,
    -- Taux de rétention en %
    round(100.0 * r.active_customers / s.cohort_size, 1)  as retention_rate
from retention_raw r
inner join cohort_size s using (cohort_month)
order by r.cohort_month, r.period_number

model.ecommerce.mart_rfm.name: mart_rfm
model.ecommerce.mart_rfm.description: Segmentation RFM — 1 ligne = 1 client avec scores R,F,M et segment nommé
model.ecommerce.mart_rfm.raw_code:
-- ============================================================
-- mart_rfm : Segmentation RFM — ST2
-- 1 ligne = 1 client avec scores R, F, M et segment nommé
-- ============================================================

with reference_date as (
    -- Date de référence = lendemain de la dernière transaction
    select max(invoice_date) + interval '1 day' as ref_date
    from fact_transactions
),

rfm_raw as (
    -- Calcul des 3 métriques brutes par client
    select
        t.customer_id,
        c.country,
        -- Récence : nb de jours depuis le dernier achat
        datediff('day', max(t.invoice_date), r.ref_date)   as recency_days,
        -- Fréquence : nb de factures distinctes
        count(distinct t.invoice_no)                        as frequency,
        -- Montant : CA total généré
        round(sum(t.line_revenue), 2)                       as monetary
    from fact_transactions t
    left join dim_customer  c using (customer_id)
    cross join reference_date r
    group by t.customer_id, c.country, r.ref_date
),

rfm_scores as (
    -- Scoring 1→5 par quintile (5 = meilleur)
    select
        customer_id,
        country,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        -- R : score inversé (récent = 5)
        ntile(5) over (order by recency_days desc)   as r_score,
        -- F : score direct (fréquent = 5)
        ntile(5) over (order by frequency asc)       as f_score,
        -- M : score direct (gros CA = 5)
        ntile(5) over (order by monetary asc)        as m_score
    from rfm_raw
),

rfm_segmented as (
    select
        customer_id,
        country,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        -- Score composite RFM
        round((r_score + f_score + m_score) / 3.0, 2)  as rfm_score,
        -- Segmentation nommée selon grille CDC
        case
            when r_score >= 4 and f_score >= 4 and m_score >= 4
                then 'Champions'
            when f_score >= 3 and m_score >= 3
                then 'Loyal Customers'

-- mart_rfm : Segmentation RFM — ST2
-- 1 ligne = 1 client avec scores R, F, M et segment nommé

with reference_date as (
    -- Date de référence = lendemain de la dernière transaction
    select max(invoice_date) + interval '1 day' as ref_date
    from fact_transactions
),

rfm_raw as (
    -- Calcul des 3 métriques brutes par client
    select
        t.customer_id,
        c.country,
        -- Récence : nb de jours depuis le dernier achat
        datediff('day', max(t.invoice_date), r.ref_date)   as recency_days,
        -- Fréquence : nb de factures distinctes
        count(distinct t.invoice_no)                        as frequency,
        -- Montant : CA total généré
        round(sum(t.line_revenue), 2)                       as monetary
    from fact_transactions t
    left join dim_customer  c using (customer_id)
    cross join reference_date r
    group by t.customer_id, c.country, r.ref_date
),

rfm_scores as (
    -- Scoring 1→5 par quintile (5 = meilleur)
    select
        customer_id,
        country,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        -- R : score inversé (récent = 5)
        ntile(5) over (order by recency_days desc)   as r_score,
        -- F : score direct (fréquent = 5)
        ntile(5) over (order by frequency asc)       as f_score,
        -- M : score direct (gros CA = 5)
        ntile(5) over (order by monetary asc)        as m_score
    from rfm_raw
),

rfm_segmented as (
    select
        customer_id,
        country,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        -- Score composite RFM
        round((r_score + f_score + m_score) / 3.0, 2)  as rfm_score,
        -- Segmentation nommée selon grille CDC
        case
            when r_score >= 4 and f_score >= 4 and m_score >= 4
                then 'Champions'
            when f_score >= 3 and m_score >= 3
                then 'Loyal Customers'
            when r_score >= 3 and f_score <= 2

                then 'New Customers'
            when r_score <= 2 and f_score >= 3
                then 'At Risk'
            when r_score <= 2 and f_score <= 2 and m_score >= 2
                then 'Hibernating'
            else 'Lost'
        end as rfm_segment
    from rfm_scores
)

-- ============================================================
-- mart_clv : Customer Lifetime Value simplifiée — ST2
-- CLV = Panier moyen × Fréquence annuelle × Durée relation
-- 1 ligne = 1 client avec CLV et comparaison CAC estimé
-- ============================================================

with base as (
    -- Agrégation par client
    select
        t.customer_id,
        -- Panier moyen par commande
        round(sum(t.line_revenue) / count(distinct t.invoice_no), 2)    as avg_basket,
        -- Nb commandes totales
        count(distinct t.invoice_no)                                     as total_orders,
        -- CA total
        round(sum(t.line_revenue), 2)                                    as total_revenue,
        -- Durée relation en mois
        datediff('month',
            min(t.invoice_date),
            max(t.invoice_date)
        ) + 1                                                            as relation_months,
        -- Première et dernière commande
        min(t.invoice_date)                                              as first_order_date,
        max(t.invoice_date)                                              as last_order_date
    from fact_transactions t
    group by t.customer_id
),

clv_computed as (
    select
        b.customer_id,
        b.avg_basket,
        b.total_orders,
        b.total_revenue,
        b.relation_months,
        b.first_order_date,
        b.last_order_date,
        -- Fréquence annuelle estimée
        round(b.total_orders / greatest(b.relation_months / 12.0, 1), 2)    as annual_frequency,
        -- Durée relation estimée (en années) — cap à 3 ans
        least(round(b.relation_months / 12.0, 2), 3.0)                      as relation_years,
        -- CLV simplifiée
        round(
            b.avg_basket
            * round(b.total_orders / greatest(b.relation_months / 12.0, 1), 2)
            * least(round(b.relation_months / 12.0, 2), 3.0),
        2)                                                                   as clv_simple,
        -- Coût rétention estimé (hypothèse : 10% du CA)
        round(b.total_revenue * 0.10, 2)                                     as retention_cost_est,
        -- CLV nette
        round(
            b.avg_basket
            * round(b.total_orders / greatest(b.relation_months / 12.0, 1), 2)
            * least(round(b.relation_months / 12.0, 2), 3.0)
            - (b.total_revenue * 0.10),
        2)                                                                   as clv_net
    from base b
),

with_segment as (
    -- Jointure avec le segment RFM
    select
        c.*,
        r.rfm_segment,
        r.rfm_score,
        r.r_score,
        r.f_score,
        r.m_score,
        r.recency_days,
        r.monetary,
        r.country,
        -- Catégorie CLV
        case
            when c.clv_simple >= 1000 then 'High Value'
            when c.clv_simple >= 300  then 'Medium Value'
            else                           'Low Value'
        end as clv_category
    from clv_computed c
    left join mart_rfm r using (customer_id)
)

select * from with_segment
order by clv_simple desc

{% macro duckdb__get_catalog(information_schema, schemas) -%}
  {%- call statement('catalog', fetch_result=True) -%}
    with relations AS (
      select
        t.table_name
        , t.database_name
        , t.schema_name
        , 'BASE TABLE' as table_type
        , t.comment as table_comment
      from duckdb_tables() t
      WHERE t.database_name = '{{ database }}'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT v.view_name as table_name
      , v.database_name
      , v.schema_name
      , 'VIEW' as table_type
      , v.comment as table_comment
      from duckdb_views() v
      WHERE v.database_name = '{{ database }}'
    )
    select
        '{{ database }}' as table_database,
        r.schema_name as table_schema,
        r.table_name,
        r.table_type,
        r.table_comment,
        c.column_name,
        c.column_index as column_index,
        c.data_type as column_type,
        c.comment as column_comment,
        NULL as table_owner
    FROM relations r JOIN duckdb_columns() c ON r.schema_name = c.schema_name AND r.table_name = c.table_name
    WHERE (
        {%- for schema in schemas -%}
          upper(r.schema_name) = upper('{{ schema }}'){%- if not loop.last %} or {% endif -%}
        {%- endfor -%}
    )
    ORDER BY
        r.schema_name,
        r.table_name,
        c.column_index
  {%- endcall -%}
  {{ return(load_result('catalog').table) }}
{%- endmacro %}

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
